lines.en: I pace up and down the hall.
Every few steps I turn my head.

lines.zh: 舞台边缘到我这里，很近。
lines.en: From the stage edge to here is close.
My feet slip on the tiles.
I steer slowly around the tables.

lines.zh: 角落的阴影我都要看一遍。
lines.en: I check every shadowed corner.

lines.zh: 走起来有点晃，能站稳就行。
lines.en: I wobble a bit. As long as I stand.
I'm not chasing anyone. Just walking.
My ear bumped the hanging lamp.
Can't push the door, so I go around.

lines.zh: 脚步声在这栋楼里很空。
lines.en: Footsteps sound hollow in this building.
I tilt my head at the wall.

lines.zh: 这身紫色布料有点旧了。
lines.en: This purple fabric is a bit old.
I'm waiting for someone to come.
Dust got into my joints.

lines.zh: 金属手指悬着，慢慢收回。
lines.en: My metal fingers hover, then slowly retract.
The light here is too yellow.
Motionless, I look like an ornament.
My face is hard plastic.

lines.zh: 有老鼠从墙里跑过去了。
lines.en: Something scurried inside the wall.
I'm counting the lights in the hall.
Are you looking at me?
Not too close. I'm not fully awake.
The paint on this face is chipping.
In the daytime I'm just a display.
Your hand is in your pocket.
I don't attack first. Really.

lines.zh: 你手上那东西，我不认识。
lines.en: I don't know what you're holding.
You're deciding whether to swing.
I stand a little taller than you.
Are the hall lights off?
The shell dented.
The paint came off there.
I stepped back and steadied.
My face still looks the same.
The fabric tore open.
It hurts. I can't show it well.

lines.zh: 抬手挡住，铁皮响了一声。
lines.en: Arm raised, the metal shell clanged.

lines.zh: 你打了我，节目就开始了。
lines.en: You hit me—now the show starts.
Food? I have no teeth in this mouth.

lines.zh: 你举着的东西我不吃了。
lines.en: I don't eat what you're holding.
I just want to see what that is.

lines.zh: 你不用喂我，说说话就行。
lines.en: No need to feed me. Just talk.

lines.zh: 我闻不出味道，只有塑料。
lines.en: I smell only plastic.
Take it away. I really don't eat.
Don't shake. I don't bite.
This is making me nervous.
I lower my head to look at it.
Is that oil or water on your hands?
Bumped. My ears wobbled.

lines.zh: 我的吉他放在台上，没带。
lines.en: My guitar is on the stage, not with me.
This shell is rather light.
Your shoulder hit my chest.
I put a hand on the wall.
Don't push. I'll hit the shelves.
I'm not angry. Really not.
One of my screws is on the floor.
I can't act this out.
Two animatronics facing each other is odd.
The joints aren't made for it.
We tapped against each other.
Don't record it. Delete that part.
It's a bit older than me.
We part and return to our spots.
Someone seems to be in the seats.
This shouldn't be done in daylight.
I pick up a scrap of cloth.
This one matches my color.
My fingers are too stiff to pinch.
I set it on the counter.
I know this part.
I'll keep what's on the floor.
My joints creak when I bend.
This circuit board still works.
A little dust on my hand.
You hit me just now.
I wasn't going to do anything.

lines.zh: 既然这样，我就不坐着了。
lines.en: Well then, I won't stay sitting.
Locked on. You started it.
Twenty a hit. Not much.
Something in my eyes changed.
Don't back toward the shelves.

lines.zh: 我的动作不快，但够得着。
lines.en: I'm not fast, but I can reach.

lines.zh: 地上的灰被我一脚踢开。
lines.en: I kick the dust off the floor.

lines.zh: 门在你身后，我这边是墙。
lines.en: Door's behind you. Wall's on my side.
I won't shout. Nobody hears anyway.

lines.zh: 你把武器举起来，我就知道了。
lines.en: Your weapon's up. Now I know.
I've saved this a long time.
I stand up. Taller than you.
Every time you move, I follow.
Don't expect me as I am by day.
I follow along the hall.

lines.zh: 你关灯了，我还是看得见。
lines.en: You killed the lights. I still see.
My steps stop at the door.

lines.zh: 你在桌子底下，我看见了。
lines.en: You're under the table. I see you.
I don't run. I walk over.
No other way behind those shelves.
I pushed the chair aside.
I circle and watch the exit.
You've backed onto the stage.
No hurry. Dawn is far off.
The corner light came on.
My head tilts toward you.
You're counting how long I last.
I hear the soles of your shoes.
This floorboard makes noise.
Your companion isn't with you.
I've split the hall in two.
Further on is a dead end.

lines.zh: 紫色的兔子，站在舞台上。
lines.en: A purple rabbit on the stage.
A light one. Try it.
I sweep with the back of my hand.
There's paint on your armor now.

lines.zh: 关节卡了一下，还是打中。
lines.en: My joint sticks, but the blow still lands.
You backed off. Don't come again.
My ear caught your shoulder.
Twenty points. I counted exactly.
I raise a foot and set it beside you.
You fell onto the table.

lines.zh: 这一下把灰都震下来了。
lines.en: That knocked the dust loose.
I press down on your shield.
A bit of the plastic cracked.
I step back. You can still stand.

lines.zh: 我这一下带着玩偶的重量。
lines.en: This one carries a doll's weight.
You're shoved into the shelf.
My fingers close slowly.
Not angry. Just doing it.
I was there when the curtain opened.
The stopper came loose. I moved.
By day I'm just on display.
The lights went out, so I got up.
I step down from the platform.

lines.zh: 这身紫衣服是我自己的。
lines.en: This purple outfit is my own.
I shudder and the joints settle.
There's no one else in the hall.

lines.zh: 我站在角落里看了很久。
lines.en: I stood in the corner a long while.
Those footsteps are mine. Don't worry.
First I looked at my own hands.
It's still dark outside.

lines.zh: 布料烧起来了，塑料在化。
lines.en: The fabric caught fire; the plastic softened.

lines.zh: 落地时我的腿弯错了方向。
lines.en: On landing my leg bent the wrong way.

lines.zh: 水进了电机，我动不了了。
lines.en: Water reached the motor. I can't move.
The blast threw me to the wall.
An arrow stuck in my chest.
That light made me pause.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，只是电量低。
lines.en: I don't eat. My power is just low.

lines.zh: 雷打中我，线路响了一声。
lines.en: Lightning hit and my wiring buzzed.

lines.zh: 往下掉的时候，我还在数灯。
lines.en: Falling, I was still counting lights.
